mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_upload_file (business_type, business_id, original_name, stored_path, file_size, content_type, created_at) VALUES (#{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_type, business_id, original_name, stored_path, file_size, content_type, created_at FROM t_upload_file WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_upload_file SET business_type = #{businessType}, business_id = #{businessId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_upload_file WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId}
